summary: The immutable snapshot (SHA-256-bound draft, 80-project memo, late inventory/decision memo, and fact-check excerpt) supports most late-cutoff dispositions, merged-source framing for 0xchat #92 and nos2x-fox #67/#69, fips2go/Zzub caveats, and the four In Development late additions with appropriate deployment limits.
